title: Shhhh free version
features:
Basically me and my friend modified the shhhh free version from Farzard github that I saved b4 it got deleted, we modified it to make it work on Hood Customs and Da Hood RipOffs, it will NOT work on normal dahood cuz im lazy to update.

It is open source, so if you are able to make it work on Normal Da Hood please dm me; z.wagg

WAVE ONLY!!! (freemium is avaiable rn)
